title: City Council District 7
statement: The Temescal Community Health Center is operational, but District 7 does not substitute ribbon-cuttings for rigorous post-occupancy oversight. With 108 sick residents in Temescal, 108 in Rockridge, and 16 in KONO, our first quarter utilization review requires verified patient intake logs and transparent cost accounting to ensure the $45M capital allocation delivers measurable care across our corridors.

payload.text: Submitting the verified fire-rated wall and drywall inspection sign-off for the Temescal Community Health Center (INIT-005) following completed structural compliance reviews.

numberMoved: 108 sick residents in Temescal monitored under first quarter clinic utilization review
